name: Halo Cart
summary: A round Add to cart button: a glowing ring fills, the cart drives out and a candle flies to the cart
about: A candle product card with a round Add to cart button. The button squashes, a coral ring fills around it led by a glowing dot while the cart icon idles, then the cart drives out of the circle, a check draws in and dots burst outward. A tiny candle flies to the header total, which pops with sparks.
how: Pick a scent: the wax colour, price and button label change with a little bounce
Press the round button: it squashes and a ring starts to fill around it
A glowing dot leads the ring while the cart engine shakes
When the ring closes the cart drives away, a green check draws in and dots burst
A small candle flies to the cart total, which pops with sparks
The ring fades, the cart rolls back in, and Clear empties the cart
